preconditions.description: There must be exactly 5 lines of input, each representing a blimp registration code.

preconditions.expression: all(len(code) <= 11 and all(c.isupper() or c.isdigit() or c == '-' for c in code) for code in stdin.splitlines())
preconditions.description: Each registration code must be at most 11 characters long and consist only of uppercase letters, digits, or dashes.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ' '.join(map(str, sorted([i + 1 for i, code in enumerate(stdin.splitlines()) if 'FBI' in code])))
postconditions.description: The output must contain the indices of the input rows that contain 'FBI', sorted in increasing order.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'HE GOT AWAY!' and not any('FBI' in code for code in stdin.splitlines())
postconditions.description: If no registration codes contain 'FBI', the output must be 'HE GOT AWAY!'.
